t.why: In 1893 it became the first country to give women the vote. It is closely connected with the Pacific island states.
t.rel: Australia's closest ally. It has kept a nuclear-free policy that bars nuclear-powered or nuclear-armed ships from its ports, and is deeply connected with the Pacific island states.
t.korea: It fought in the Korean War, and many Korean students go there to study.
t.know: New Zealand was the first country to give women the vote in national elections, in 1893.
t.etext: Farm products such as dairy, lamb, beef and kiwifruit, plus tourism and international students, are its main sources of income. Its dairy cooperative, which makes milk powder and butter, is a global player.
